name: Charlessa Thatcher
reason: Too thin for a page: apart from her one Omega workshop (co-led with Vince Sauter, who already has a plan), her only own material is a shared site and YouTube channel with Theda Zawaiza (one 8-minute promo video, 17 subscribers) offering donation-based qigong, tai chi and yoga classes through a single sign-up form with no pages of their own, framed largely around self-healing and chronic pain; no books.
